paragraphs: R' Hanina bar Shalka — Tanchuma, Ki Tetzei 10,[^1][^2]

notes.text: The final י in תצא״י is read as 10 after the parashah Ki Tetzei. No named edition is independently checked.
Shalka is a conventional vocalization of שלקא. The supplied notice ends with a comma; no continuation is supplied. The abbreviated title remains R'.
